question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: a JSON-RPC tools/list with no params, Content-Type application/json, Accept application/json and text/event-stream, sent after an initialize on the same endpoint answered 200

decoded.preceding-initialize: 200, serverInfo firecrawl-fastmcp 3.25.2, instructions naming those same three tools as the keyless surface; the handshake is this request's precondition and the first half of the command below

finding: With no credential, the hosted Firecrawl MCP server lists exactly the three tools its rate-limit page says a keyless connection exposes: firecrawl_scrape, firecrawl_search and firecrawl_parse. So the keyless surface is advertised to a stranger as documented. This record measures the listing only; whether a listed tool can be called keyless is measured separately in p-20260922-firecrawl-mcp-keyless-tool-call, and on this date it could not. Listing a tool is not calling it.

reproducibility.command: curl -sS -X POST https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"probe","version":"1.0"}}}' && curl -sS -X POST https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"}'
